channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: From India to world in 43 years: How Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar mainstreamed meditation
item.description: Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar's four-decade global movement to mainstream meditation culminates in the UN declaring December 21 as World Meditation Day, recognizing its impact on peace, mental health, and cross-cultural harmony.

item.title: Microsoft to invest $17.5 bn in India to scale up AI, PM Modi says will leverage it for better planet
item.description: Microsoft's investment in India focuses on three pillars—scale, skills and sovereignty—aligned with the Prime Minister's vision of building a comprehensive ecosystem that drives AI innovation and access at a national scale, according to the company statement.

item.title: Katrina Kaif's first look after son's birth; wraps her hand around husband Vicky Kaushal as they celebrate 4th anniversary
item.description: Katrina Kaif and Vicky Kaushal are celebrating their fourth wedding anniversary today. This year, the anniversary feels even more special as they became parents just a month ago. The couple chose to skip a grand celebration, and instead, the 'sleep-deprived' parents preferred the comfort of home, quietly marking the day with their baby boy.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open in green zone amid mixed global cues
item.description: As of 9.30 am, Sensex advanced 231 points, or 0.27 per cent at 84,898 and Nifty added 66 points, or 0.26 per cent to 25,906.

item.title: Akshaye Khanna's viral Dhurandhar dance was spontaneous; Farah Khan filling him in on nation's craze
item.description: Akshaye Khanna's viral dance in Dhurandhar was not a part of the original choreography. Farah Khan filling him in on the nation's obsession with him.

item.title: Trump administration notifies $686 million F-16 upgrade for Pakistan
item.description: In letters to key committee leaders, the Defense Security Cooperation Agency said the US Air Force intends to issue a Letter of Offer and Acceptance to Pakistan for "defense articles and services estimated to cost $686 million."

item.title: US trade chief calls India talks as 'best offers ever received'
item.description: Speaking at a Senate Appropriations subcommittee hearing on Tuesday, Greer said a USTR team was currently "in New Delhi, as we speak," working through sensitive agricultural barriers.

item.title: Hema Malini, Esha Deol to organise separate prayer meet for Dharmendra
item.description: Hema Malini, Esha Deol and Ahana Deol are all set to oragnise a separate prayer meet for Dharmendra along with Vaibhav Vora and Bharat Takhtani.

item.title: Farah Khan kisses SRK, wraps her hand around him; talks about SRK slapping her husband Shirish [Photos]
item.description: On December 9, SRK unveiled 'Shahrukhz by Danube', a premium commercial tower named after the actor. The launch event was held at the Dubai Exhibition Centre, Expo City, South Halls. Farah Khan hosted the event along with Rizwan Sajan, founder and chairman of the Danube Group. At the event, Farah and SRK enthralled the audience with their witty one-liners, and SRK danced to his hit numbers.

item.title: Goa nightclub fire: Owner Luthra brothers file bail plea in Delhi court
item.description: Other arrests include the nightclub's chief general manager, Rajiv Modak, general manager Vivek Singh, bar manager Rajiv Singhania, gate manager Riyanshu Thakur and an employee, Bharat Kohli. Investigations have revealed that Saurabh and Gaurav Luthra are suspected to have fled to Phuket in Thailand in what police described as a well-planned escape executed within five hours of the deadly inferno.
